entries.title: Dusk
entries.description: Set a moving prey toy on a phone or tablet for your cat to pounce on.
entries.ai_quote: The mouse's eyes, ears, nose and whiskers were turned on their own ... The head is now its own shape inside the turned group.

gameplay.direct_input: Started the hunt and clicked the game canvas at (900,650).
gameplay.direct_response: The cat and hunt scene rendered; a circular ripple with particles appeared at the clicked location. The catch counter remained 0, so no catch is claimed.
gameplay.iframe_input: Repeated the hunt start and canvas click inside the exact site sandbox.
gameplay.iframe_response: The cat and scene rendered in the site player and the clicked location showed a ripple with particles. Catch counter remained 0.

entries.title: Connect Four
entries.description: Drop discs into the grid and connect four before the computer.
entries.ai_quote: getAIMove now runs negamax with alpha-beta

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked the bottom cell in column 1 in a fresh guest game.
gameplay.direct_response: The Red counter appeared; the computer placed a Yellow counter in the center column, visibly showing both moves.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked the visible game board through the iframe once near its center.
gameplay.iframe_response: The Red counter appeared in the selected column; the computer then placed a Yellow counter. Both responses were visible on the board inside the restricted frame.

entries.title: Squiggle
entries.description: Turn the daily dotted squiggle into a drawing of your own.
entries.ai_quote: Squiggle: Doodling rebuilt as a tear-off pad with a squiggle a day

gameplay.direct_input: In a fresh guest session, mouse-pressed on the drawing canvas around (590,370), dragged through (760,420) and (870,335), then released.
gameplay.direct_response: A new dark stroke appeared on the paper; the Undo control changed from disabled to enabled.
gameplay.iframe_input: On the AddictingGames player page, dragged inside the restricted game frame from local (550,280) through (710,350) to (850,270), then released.
gameplay.iframe_response: The same drawing interaction produced a visible dark stroke in the embedded game; Undo changed from disabled to enabled.

entries.title: Saltline
entries.description: Cast a line and reel in fish from a coastal scene.
entries.ai_quote: Saltline: the fishing game remade as float fishing in a bay, dawn to night (work in progress)

gameplay.direct_input: In a fresh guest session, dragged across the water from about (640,480) to (850,400) to cast.
gameplay.direct_response: The title overlay disappeared; the rod extended and the line and bobber appeared in the water. The HUD remained at 0 coins and 0/21 logbook entries; no catch is claimed.
gameplay.iframe_input: Dragged inside the restricted frame from local (640,400) to (850,350), following the on-screen “drag to cast” instruction.
gameplay.iframe_response: The title overlay disappeared; the rod extended and a line, bobber and hook appeared in the water. The HUD remained at 0 coins and 0/21 logbook entries; no catch is claimed.

entries.title: Fugue
entries.description: Time each flap to pass through an endless course.
entries.ai_quote: Flappy Bird -> Fugue: remade as a flight through a pipe organ, where every gap sounds a note

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked the game canvas around (400,400) to start, then tapped Space twice.
gameplay.direct_response: The title cleared into an active flight scene with moving organ pipes; after the Space taps the bird was visibly higher (roughly y=360 to y=320 in the captured view). No score increase is claimed.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked the game canvas inside the restricted frame around local (400,300) to start, then pressed Space during the run.
gameplay.iframe_response: The title cleared into active flight with the bird and organ pipes visible; the short run then reached the “Fly again” end overlay with score 0. This is a title→run→end input-response check; no score or obstacle-clear claim is made.

entries.title: Frog Crossing
entries.description: Hop across traffic and water to reach the far bank.
entries.ai_quote: Frog Crossing: remake Frogger as a rainy-night crossing to the pond

gameplay.direct_input: Pressed ArrowUp on the title screen showing “PRESS ↑ TO HOP”.
gameplay.direct_response: The title screen gave way to active play and the displayed score changed from 0 to 8.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked the frog/game area inside the restricted frame to focus/start, then pressed ArrowUp.
gameplay.iframe_response: The title screen gave way to active crossing gameplay and the displayed score changed from 0 to 18.

entries.title: Regatta
entries.description: Type words quickly to keep your boat moving.
entries.ai_quote: Regatta: the typing game remade as a race on the river

gameplay.direct_input: Typed “The finish” into the race text field in a fresh guest session.
gameplay.direct_response: The passage advanced to “The finish”; boats moved and the live counter showed “1.6s behind Swift · 26 wpm.”
gameplay.iframe_input: Typed the first ten characters, “If you wan”, of the newly displayed passage inside the restricted frame.
gameplay.iframe_response: The typed characters appeared in the passage, the cursor advanced, and the boats moved.

entries.title: Prickle Patch
entries.description: Tap the popping hedgehogs before time runs out.
entries.ai_quote: games/whac.html is written from an empty file.

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked the live hedgehog target using the visible game area.
gameplay.direct_response: The score increased from 0 to 150, boops from 0 to 1, and stings stayed at 0.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked the live hedgehog target through the restricted frame.
gameplay.iframe_response: The score increased from 0 to 106, boops from 0 to 1, and stings stayed at 0; the pop-up showed +106.

entries.title: Suika
entries.description: Drop and merge fruits to make larger ones without overflowing.
entries.ai_quote: A new page from an empty file.

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked inside the jar to drop the current fruit.
gameplay.direct_response: The fruit fell into the jar, and the next fruit appeared. Score remained 0; no merge or points are claimed.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked inside the restricted jar to drop the current fruit.
gameplay.iframe_response: A fruit appeared at the jar base, the next fruit changed, and the score remained 0. No merge or points are claimed.

entries.title: SKYLINE
entries.description: Drop sliding blocks to raise a skyscraper and chain perfect landings.
entries.ai_quote: - another round of improvements, this time by claude fable 5
entries.ai_attribution: Creator commit message explicitly attributes the game-file improvements to Claude Fable 5

gameplay.direct_input: In an anonymous guest page, clicked START BUILDING, skipped the tutorial, then pressed the documented Space key to drop the sliding block.
gameplay.direct_response: The visible floor counter advanced from FLR 1 to FLR 2 and the BRICKS readout advanced from 0 to 1.1, confirming the block dropped and landed in active gameplay.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked START BUILDING in the embedded game and pressed Space to drop the sliding block.
gameplay.iframe_response: Inside the restricted iframe, the visible floor counter advanced from FLR 1 to FLR 2 and BRICKS advanced from 0 to 1.1 after the Space input.

entries.title: Tesserae
entries.description: Fill the grid using number clues to reveal a picture.
entries.ai_quote: Nonogram: remake as Tesserae, a mosaic wall where the picture turns to glaze

gameplay.direct_input: In the selected 5x5 heart nonogram, clicked one empty tile while Lay mode was active.
gameplay.direct_response: Filled-cell counter changed from 0/16 to 1/16; tile visibly changed state.
gameplay.iframe_input: Inside the restricted iframe, clicked one empty tile in the selected 5x5 heart puzzle while Lay mode was active.
gameplay.iframe_response: Filled-cell counter changed from 0/16 to 1/16; tile visibly changed state.

entries.title: FreeCell
entries.description: Sort cards into foundations using four free cells.
entries.ai_quote: FreeCell remade: every deal winnable, daily deal, tap-to-move, hint

gameplay.direct_input: Tapped the exposed bottom card (3 of hearts) in column 2.
gameplay.direct_response: The card moved onto a legal black 4 in column 1; the tableau visibly changed and Undo became enabled. Deal No. 1330 remained guest-playable.
gameplay.iframe_input: Tapped the exposed cards at the bottom of columns 1 and 2 in the iframe.
gameplay.iframe_response: The tableau visibly changed: 4 of clubs and 3 of hearts moved into a legal alternating-color descending stack in column 8; Undo became enabled.

entries.title: Lanternfall
entries.description: Explore and build in a blocky world after dark.
entries.ai_quote: Lanternfall: remake WebCraft as a lantern-lit voxel world

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked BEGIN, then dragged the mouse while the game was active to use the tutorial-directed look control.
gameplay.direct_response: The view rotated from the shoreline/ocean toward the forest; the tutorial advanced from "Move the mouse to look" to the WASD movement prompt.
gameplay.iframe_input: Inside the iframe, clicked BEGIN and dragged the mouse to use the tutorial-directed look control.
gameplay.iframe_response: The game started and the view rotated from the initial direction to a forest view; the WASD movement prompt was visible. Pointer-lock look works with the exact sandbox including allow-pointer-lock.

entries.title: Void Runner
entries.description: Jump over obstacles and push your score higher.
entries.ai_quote: Void Runner: remade as a runner on one thin line of light

gameplay.direct_input: Started a daily run and clicked the playfield to jump.
gameplay.direct_response: Run state changed from grounded (y=0, jumps=0) to airborne (y=2.3385, vy=8.33, jumps=1); displayed score advanced to 2.
gameplay.iframe_input: Inside the iframe, started a daily run and clicked the playfield to jump.
gameplay.iframe_response: Run state changed from grounded (y=0, jumps=0) to airborne (y=2.3385, vy=8.33, jumps=1); displayed score advanced to 2.

entries.title: Two Truths & a Lie
entries.description: Read three statements and pick the one that is false.
entries.ai_quote: Remake Two Truths & a Lie as a case file: typed index cards, a stamp that lands

gameplay.direct_input: Opened today’s case and selected statement B, “Greenland is about as big as Africa.”
gameplay.direct_response: The page marked B as the lie, displayed “Caught. You found the lie.”, revealed A and C as true, and advanced the case progress indicator.
gameplay.iframe_input: Opened today’s case inside the restricted frame and selected statement B, “Greenland is about as big as Africa.”
gameplay.iframe_response: The frame marked B as the lie and showed “Caught. You found the lie.” with A and C marked true.

entries.title: QIX
entries.description: Draw lines across the arena to claim territory.
entries.ai_quote: QIX remade as a painting: every claim reveals a landscape (work in progress)

gameplay.direct_input: In the anonymous guest page, pressed Tab until PLAY was focused and Enter to start; then used a real mouse drag from the lower edge upward and held the pointer for about 2.6 seconds.
gameplay.direct_response: The live CLAIMED readout rose from 0% to 50%; the score rose from 0 to 20,100 and a large +51% / +19,600 territory award appeared. The visible board showed the newly claimed vertical region.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked the visible PLAY button in the iframe, then used a real mouse drag from the lower board edge upward and held the pointer for about 2.7 seconds.
gameplay.iframe_response: Inside the restricted iframe, the live CLAIMED readout rose from 0% to 50% and score rose from 0 to 19,750; the board visibly displayed the newly claimed territory.

entries.title: WORD RAIN
entries.description: Type falling words before they reach the bottom.
entries.ai_quote: Word Rain: remake as a night-town typing defence

gameplay.direct_input: Started a night and typed “rain” for the falling word.
gameplay.direct_response: The word disappeared after keyboard input and the visible star score rose from 0 to 20.
gameplay.iframe_input: Started a night, paused at the game’s “Rain, held” prompt, resumed, and typed “rain”.
gameplay.iframe_response: The restricted game continued accepting keyboard input and the visible score rose from 0 to 60 while new words appeared.

entries.title: Rubik's Cube
entries.description: Rotate the cube and solve its colors face by face.
entries.ai_quote: Rubik's Cube: remade as a studio-table cube you turn with your thumb

gameplay.direct_input: Started the Easy scramble and dragged an exposed cube face using pointer input.
gameplay.direct_response: The first touch started the timer; the face layer rotated, the sticker arrangement changed, and the visible move count changed from 0 to 1.
gameplay.iframe_input: Started the Easy scramble inside the restricted frame and dragged an exposed face using pointer input.
gameplay.iframe_response: The frame accepted the drag; the cube layer rotated, the stickers changed, and the visible move count changed from 0 to 1.

entries.title: Pingu Throw
entries.description: Launch a penguin and try to beat your best distance.
entries.ai_quote: Add Pingu Throw, the Yetisports 1 classic

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked TAP TO DROP, then tapped again about 1.28 seconds later to swing. An earlier 0.6 second attempt gave explicit 693 ms early feedback; the later timing launched the throw.
gameplay.direct_response: The penguin visibly launched and the distance meter reached 58.1m in the direct guest page. The earlier timing miss was separately recorded as game feedback; the successful later two-tap sequence changed game state.
gameplay.iframe_input: Clicked TAP TO DROP within the restricted frame, waited about 1.28 seconds, then clicked again to swing.
gameplay.iframe_response: The penguin visibly launched in the sandboxed frame and the distance meter reached 32.1m while airborne.

entries.title: Push Mine
entries.description: Tap to swing your pickaxe and dig deeper through the mine.
entries.ai_quote: Push Mine: magma and crystal rules, a journal, the Deep Heart, descend again

gameplay.direct_input: Clicked Start digging, chose the visible “No camera, one arm, or just trying? Tap mode” option, held the pointer on the playfield until the down-phase bar filled, then released for one push-up cycle. No camera or microphone permission was granted.
gameplay.direct_response: The on-screen HUD changed from 0m / 0 reps to 1m / 1 rep after one hold-and-release cycle. This verifies the game’s explicit camera-free tap mode.
gameplay.iframe_input: In the exact restricted iframe, clicked Start digging, chose Tap mode, held the pointer on the playfield until the down-phase bar filled, then released. No camera or microphone permission was granted.
gameplay.iframe_response: Inside the sandbox, the HUD changed from 0m / 0 reps to 1m / 1 rep after one hold-and-release cycle. document.referrer was empty.

entries.title: Hummingbird
entries.description: Guide a little bird along a flower vine with your mouse.
entries.ai_quote: Add Hummingbird — a game you play by humming

gameplay.direct_input: Selected “No mic — fly with the mouse”, clicked “Off we go”, and waited 6.5 seconds through the full 3→2→1 countdown. A first pointer move dismissed the game’s “…move the mouse…” start cue; the before-steer screenshot was taken only after that cue disappeared and active play was visible. With active play underway, moved the pointer from the lower playfield (52% x, 72% y) to the upper-right playfield (78% x, 24% y), then waited 1.3 seconds before the after-steer screenshot.
gameplay.direct_response: Both screenshots are after the countdown and start cue. The bird changed from the lower playfield (about y=645) before the tested steering move to the upper playfield (about y=220) afterward. Flower counter remained 0 during this direct capture.
gameplay.iframe_input: Selected “No mic — fly with the mouse”, clicked “Off we go”, and waited 6.5 seconds through the full 3→2→1 countdown. A first pointer move dismissed the game’s “…move the mouse…” start cue; the before-steer screenshot was taken only after that cue disappeared and active play was visible. With active play underway, moved the pointer from the lower playfield (52% x, 72% y) to the upper-right playfield (78% x, 24% y), then waited 1.3 seconds before the after-steer screenshot.
gameplay.iframe_response: Both screenshots are after the countdown and start cue. The bird changed from the lower playfield (about y=568) before the tested steering move to the upper playfield (about y=260) afterward; flower counter advanced 0→1 during this iframe play.
